items.question: What cosmic consequence follows from feeding a maiden in ritual?
premises: A maiden is ritually fed by someone.

items.inference: Therefore, one who feeds a maiden effectively feeds all three worlds.
items.plain_english: By whom a maiden is fed, by him the three worlds are fed.
